intent: Original homepage illustrations, adjusted to middle-school cartoon characters after user feedback.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Make a fresh original website mascot illustration for a MIDDLE-SCHOOL mathematics learning website. Style MUST be cute hand-painted 2D chibi educational cartoon: oversized rounded head occupying ONE THIRD of total height, SHORT compact torso and SHORT limbs, rounded cheeks, tiny button nose, large simplified lively eyes, very simple flat cel shading with subtle soft gradients, clean rounded outlines. These are cheerful 12–14-year-old junior middle-school pupils in a storybook cartoon world. They must NOT look like adults, adult anime characters, fashion models, realistic portraits, or tall mature teenagers. No realistic skin rendering, no mature jawlines or adult body proportions, no long legs. Wholesome, lively, curious classroom mood. Matching colors: powder sky blue, periwinkle lavender, white, navy, small butter-yellow accents. A full-body compact character and a few small maths props, square image composition, entire shoes and all props inside frame, 6% transparent breathing room, genuinely TRANSPARENT background with clean alpha. No colored backdrop, no large glow, no floor, no text, no watermark, no speech bubble, no brand or school logo. Subject: one BOY with soft tousled dark brown hair, smiling brightly. Wears a blue-and-white zip-up school sports jacket, navy school trousers, small white-and-blue sneakers. About THREE heads tall. He is seated on two small oversized pastel books, happily holding up a lavender triangle ruler and using his other hand to place a yellow triangle onto a blue cube. A few chunky geometry blocks at his feet, two tiny yellow sparkles near his head. Face and torso turned slightly to the right toward the center of the future webpage. Very clear readable silhouette, charming cartoon school mascot, not a handsome adolescent portrait.
